takes.prompt: Locked-off tripod shot. The pen tip travels a short way to the right along one ruled line at natural speed and stops; the fingers around the barrel keep the same grip and the forearm propping the notebook stays where it is. The page keeps only the two faint marks already on it and its ruled lines. Everything else remains still and the light stays constant.
